title: Binance Stocks Now Supports API Trading
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that API trading is now available for Binance Stocks. Users can now trade U.S.-listed stocks and ETFs programmatically through a secure and developer-friendly REST API. With API support, both retail and institutional users can automate trading, manage positions, access data, and seamlessly integrate Binance Stocks into their existing trading systems. Key Highlights: Programmatic Portfolio Management:  Build and deploy programmatic trading strategies, enabling more efficient execution and portfolio management. Easy Integration with Full Access:  Existing Binance API users can integrate Binance Stocks trading into their workflows with minimal effort, accessing U.S. stocks and ETFs alongside crypto from one API. Seamless Conversion to bStocks:  Mint equity holdings into bStocks — tokenized representations of selected U.S. stocks and ETFs — directly via API, enabling on-chain flexibility and composability. About Binance Stocks: Binance Stocks allows users to trade U.S.-listed stocks and ETFs directly from their Binance account. With access to thousands of stocks and ETFs, fractional shares starting from just $5, and 24/5 trading hours, Binance brings crypto and traditional financial assets together in one unified experience.
